external_deps: Claude Code, Cursor CLI or Codex CLI

review.tagline: Web and mobile UI for Claude Code, Cursor CLI and Codex sessions
review.summary: Runs a local Node.js server (default port 3001) that gives a browser front end to Claude Code, Cursor CLI and Codex. It auto-discovers existing sessions from ~/.claude and adds chat, a shell terminal, a file explorer with editing, and a Git view for staging, committing and switching branches. MCP settings are read from and written to the same Claude Code config, and a plugin system adds custom tabs.
review.audience: Developers who run Claude Code, Cursor CLI or Codex from a browser or phone
strengths: Auto-discovers existing sessions and shares MCP and permission config with native Claude Code
Covers three agent CLIs: Claude Code, Cursor CLI and Codex
Built-in file editor, Git explorer and shell terminal alongside chat
Plugin system with a starter template for adding tabs and backend services
weaknesses: AGPL-3.0: modified versions run as a network service must publish source
Requires your own Claude, Cursor or Codex subscription; it supplies no models
Self-hosted host machine must stay on; team sharing is only in paid CloudCLI Cloud
Docker sandbox mode is experimental and supports only Claude Code and Codex
needs: Needs Node.js 22+, Claude Code, Cursor CLI or Codex CLI, sbx CLI (sandbox mode only)
